items.summary: CTO review: approve the CEO/CFO no-new-implementation posture. The proposed finance report is technically feasible using existing snapshots, but it duplicates the active CFO evidence work and must not create a second telemetry or reporting request. Keep aggregate commission unassigned, preserve unavailable infrastructure and labor costs as unknown, and make no ROI, margin, causal-lift, or budget claims. Prioritize isolated triage of failed requests and open repair items, completion of existing measurement windows, and reconciliation of approved-but-unexecuted work before new queue entries. SearchWoot remains private pending owner authorization and all technical, security, legal, accuracy, and measurement gates.

CTO disposition: no new change request is queue-safe this cycle. The action mandate reports no eligible candidate, existing implementation and repair queues are active, and operational deployment/fleet-doctor evidence is unavailable. Continue only existing bounded work with isolated worktrees, focused validation, explicit rollback, and available telemetry; do not add dependencies, credentials, configuration, DNS, schedules, spending, or cross-site changes.
